votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to approve the resolution authorizing the issuance of Industrial Revenue Bonds Series 2020 in an amount not to $7,5000,000 by the City of St. George, as issuer, for the construction and related improvements of a healthcare facility for southwest Utah Community Health Center, Inc dba Family Healthcare for the general welfare of the residents of the State of Utah subject to approval by the Legal Department.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
